purpose: Select event-conditioned parameter families per target/control from historical analogs, while retaining a robust multi-event fallback. The selector supports research forecasts but does not issue warnings or evacuation decisions.

targets.name: Santa Tereza
targets.notes: RNA/eventwise evidence exists; HEC discharge library waits on reconciled target Q/rating-curve evidence.

targets.name: Triunfo
targets.notes: checkpoint only; does not define G040 spatial domain

selector.weighting: inverse-distance soft weighting among compatible analogs
selector.fallback: robust multi-event parameterization when no sufficiently similar/validated analog exists
selector.minimum_evidence: an analog must have a compatible target-specific parameter row and historical fingerprint
selector.target_event_exclusion: pseudo-operational replay must exclude the target event from its candidate library and may only use observations available at t0
selector.online_recalibration: optional research arm; may use observations only up to t0 and must be separately benchmarked

confidence.high: top analog close and clearly separated from alternatives, all critical features available
confidence.medium: usable analogs exist but distances are similar or some features are missing
confidence.low: no close analog, weak target library, or conflicting upstream state; use robust fallback/ensemble

no_single_parameter_rule: Do not replace the eventwise library with one basin-wide parameter set. A common/multi-event fit remains a fallback and scientific comparator.
